title: Tanglewood Treasure | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled within the exclusive Canyon Mesa Golf Country Club in the Village of Oak Creek, this fully remodeled bohemian mid-century townhouse offers an enchanting blend of style and comfort, all framed by breathtaking red rock views. The 1,524-square-foot home, with its two bedrooms and two bathrooms, provides a serene retreat for up to four guests. The open floor plan effortlessly connects the cozy living room, adorned with a leather sofa and a 65” Smart TV, to the sleek, fully equipped kitchen. Whether dining casually at the bistro table or enjoying a more formal meal under the bohemian chandelier, every moment spent here is infused with warmth and charm. The outdoor patio serves as a tranquil oasis where guests can relax in a hanging chair or dine alfresco while soaking in the iconic Sedona landscape. Inside, the master suite is a sanctuary of luxury with a king bed, 43” Smart TV, and an en suite bathroom featuring a soaking tub and a rainfall shower. The second bedroom offers a peaceful retreat with a queen bed and access to a full shared bathroom. The townhouse is set within a gated community that offers exceptional amenities, including pools, tennis, pickleball courts, and a nine-hole golf course, making it an ideal base for both relaxation and adventure.
